metadata.title: Dataset and artifacts for "Too Many Reports, Too Few Handovers: A Large-Scale Study of Configuration Inefficiencies in Operational 5G Networks"
metadata.description:
Raw and processed measurement data behind the CoNEXT 2026 paper Too Many Reports, Too Few Handovers: A Large-Scale Study of Configuration Inefficiencies in Operational 5G Networks (Proc. ACM Netw. 4, CoNEXT4, Article 64).

The dataset covers 15,000+ km of driving across the United States between 2022 and 2024, measuring the three major US operators (AT&T, T-Mobile, Verizon) with XCAL Solo. It contains the raw operator-side control-plane exports — RRC message logs, signalling flow (protocol ladder), per-second PHY/KPI time series, and 5G SIB dumps — together with a trimmed set of processed pickles sufficient to regenerate the figures in the paper.

Analysis and figure-generation code: https://github.com/NUWiNS/conext26-handover-paper-dataset

See MANIFEST.md in the code repository for the file-by-file inventory, and raw/README.md for the integrity and summary scripts.
